integrity: The accompanying source-only C++ checker enumerates all 34,219 high pairs in orders 4..60 and certifies 2,352 inconsistent faithful systems; a Python witness checker independently validates the five constructive group types.
scientific_limitations: The exact five-value spectrum concerns simplices with cyclic full finite simplex group, a>=1 and k>=2; not noncyclic types, all equivalence classes, or arbitrary trinomial exponents. Exclusions are analytically reduced to a finite exact modular test, with independent scientific audit not performed.
title: Exact cyclic volume spectrum for two-top-height trinomial Ehrhart simplices
